papers.title: OS-Marathon: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents on Long-Horizon Repetitive Tasks
papers.authors: Jing Wu, Daphne Barretto, Yiye Chen, Nicholas Gydé, Yanan Jian, Yuhang He, Vibhav Vineet
papers.affiliations: 1 University of Oxford, 2 Microsoft, 3 Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出了OS-Marathon基准（含242个长期重复性任务）和轻量级上下文学习方法FCWD（Few-shot Condensed Workflow Demonstration），以评测和提升CUA在长期重复性工作流上的表现。

papers.title: Go-Browse: Training Web Agents with Structured Exploration
papers.authors: Apurva Gandhi, Graham Neubig
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University
papers.intro: Go-Browse提出一种基于图搜索的结构化探索方法，通过外循环维护探索前沿、内循环进行任务提议/可行性检查/轨迹采样，自动收集高质量Web代理训练数据，在WebArena上微调7B模型达到21.7%成功率，超越GPT-4o mini和当前子10B参数模型最优结果。

papers.title: UI-Ins: Enhancing GUI Grounding with Multi-Perspective Instruction as Reasoning
papers.authors: Liangyu Chen, Hanzhang Zhou, chenglin cai, Jianan Zhang, Panrong Tong, Xu Zhang, Quyu Kong, Chen Liu, Yuqi Liu, Wenxuan Wang, Yue Wang, Qin Jin, Steven HOI
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group（第一作者标注：中国人民大学、阿里巴巴通义实验室），具体见十二、作者机构
papers.intro: 本文提出Instruction-as-Reasoning范式，通过数据清洗与多视角指令增强，结合SFT+GRPO两阶段训练，使模型能够将指令视为动态推理路径并自主选择最优分析视角，在多个GUI grounding基准上取得SOTA结果，并展现涌现推理能力。

papers.title: ProRe: A Proactive Reward System for GUI Agents via Reasoner–Actor Collaboration
papers.authors: Gaole Dai, Shiqi Jiang, Ting Cao, Yuqing Yang, Yuanchun Li, Rui Tan, Mo Li, Lili Qiu
papers.affiliations: Gaole Dai - 南洋理工大学（NTU）（实习期间在微软研究院完成工作）；Shiqi Jiang - 微软研究院；Ting Cao - 清华大学；Yuqing Yang - 微软研究院；Yuanchun Li - 清华大学；Rui Tan - 南洋理工大学；Mo Li - 香港科技大学（HKUST）；Lili Qiu - 微软研究院
papers.intro: PRORE提出一种协作式主动奖励系统，通过通用推理器（reasoner）规划状态探测任务，由领域特定的评估智能体（actor）主动与环境交互收集额外状态信息，再通过链式声明推理（chain-of-claims reasoning）生成可验证的奖励信号，从而显著提升GUI智能体奖励的准确性和下游任务成…

papers.title: WALT: Web Agents that Learn Tools
papers.authors: Viraj Prabhu, Yutong Dai, Matthew Fernandez, Krithika Ramakrishnan, Jing Gu, Yanqi Luo, silvio savarese, Caiming Xiong, Junnan Li, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu
papers.affiliations: Salesforce Research
papers.intro: WALT提出一种框架，通过逆向工程将网站潜在功能（搜索、过滤、排序等）反编码为可复用的确定性工具，将脆弱逐步推理转变为可靠的高层工具调用，在多个基准上取得最优结果。

papers.title: GUI-Shift: Enhancing VLM-Based GUI Agents through Self-supervised Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Longxi Gao, Li Zhang, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Mengwei Xu
papers.affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Independent Researcher
papers.intro: 提出 GUI-Shift，一种自监督强化学习框架，通过 K-step GUI Transition 任务和 GRPO 算法在无标注 GUI 轨迹上训练 VLM，从而在无需人工指令的情况下提升 GUI 自动化与定位任务性能。

papers.title: PI2I: A Personalized Item-Based Collaborative Filtering Retrieval Framework
papers.authors: Shaoqing Wang, Yingcai Ma, Kairui Fu, Ziyang Wang, Dunxian Huang, Yuliang Yan, Jian Wu
papers.affiliations: 阿里巴巴集团（杭州、北京）；浙江大学（Kairui Fu）
papers.intro: 本文提出PI2I，一种两阶段个性化物品到物品协同过滤检索框架，通过放宽截断阈值构建高召回候选池，再利用交互式评分模型对候选精细打分，在淘宝“猜你喜欢”场景上线后交易率提升1.05%，并开源了包含1.3亿交互记录的大规模推荐数据集。

papers.title: EvoCUA: Evolving Computer Use Agents via Learning from Scalable Synthetic Experience
papers.authors: Taofeng Xue, Chong Peng, Mianqiu Huang, Linsen Guo, Tiancheng Han, Haozhe Wang, Jianing Wang, Xiaocheng Zhang, Xin Yang, Dengchang Zhao, Jinrui Ding, Xiandi Ma, Yuchen Xie, Peng Pei, Xunliang Cai, Xipeng Qiu
papers.affiliations: Meituan, Fudan University, Tongji University, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出EvoCUA，通过将数据生成与策略优化整合到自我维持的进化循环中，利用可验证合成引擎、可扩展交互基础设施和基于经验的迭代学习范式，在OSWorld基准上以56.7%的成功率达成开源新最优。

papers.title: YOLO26: An Analysis of NMS-Free End to End Framework for Real-Time Object Detection
papers.authors: Sudip Chakrabarty
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Engineering, KIIT University
papers.intro: 本文对YOLO26框架进行了全面的架构分析，该模型通过消除NMS和DFL，采用原生端到端的回归策略和创新的训练动态（MuSGD、STAL、ProgLoss），在COCO基准测试上实现了对新旧CNN及Transformer架构的速度-精度帕累托主导，并分析了其对边缘部署中“导出差距”和确定性延迟的影响…

papers.title: CaMeLs Can Use Computers Too: System-level Security for Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Hanna Foerster, Tom Blanchard, Kristina Nikolić, Ilia Shumailov, Cheng Zhang, Robert Mullins, Nicolas Papernot, Florian Tramèr, Yiren Zhao
papers.affiliations: University of Cambridge, University of Toronto & Vector Institute, ETH Zurich, AI Sequrity Company
papers.intro: 本文提出CaMeL-NOVA，首个将Dual-LLM架构隔离成功应用于Computer Use Agents的系统，通过单次规划生成包含分支的完整计划实现控制流完整性，并在保留实用性的同时识别了新的数据流威胁——分支转向（Branch Steering）攻击。

papers.title: SpatCode: Rotary-based Unified Encoding Framework for Efficient Spatiotemporal Vector Retrieval
papers.authors: Bingde Hu, Enhao Pan, Wanjing Zhou, Yang Gao, Zunlei Feng, Hao Zhong
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Bingde Hu, Enhao Pan, Yang Gao, Zunlei Feng, Hao Zhong）；南京大学（Wanjing Zhou）
papers.intro: SpatCode提出一种基于旋转编码的统一时空向量检索框架，将时间、地理位置与多模态内容特征嵌入到同一向量空间，通过标准ANN检索实现高效、可扩展、自适应的时空语义联合检索。

papers.title: GUI-Eyes: Tool-Augmented Perception for Visual Grounding in GUI Agents
papers.authors: Chen Chen, Jiawei Shao, Dakuan Lu, Haoyi Hu, Xiangcheng Liu, Hantao Yao, Wu Liu
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, multimodal learning, gui
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 提出GUI-Eyes框架，通过强化学习训练GUI代理在推理中主动决定是否及如何使用裁剪/缩放等视觉工具，实现渐进式感知，在ScreenSpot-Pro上用3k样本达到44.8%准确率，大幅超越现有方法。

papers.title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Reranker: A Unified Framework for State-of-the-Art Multimodal Retrieval and Ranking
papers.authors: Mingxin Li, Yanzhao Zhang, Dingkun Long, Keqin Chen, Sibo Song, Shuai Bai, Zhibo Yang, Pengjun Xie, An Yang, Dayiheng Liu, Jingren Zhou, Junyang Lin
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出了基于Qwen3-VL基础模型的嵌入（Qwen3-VL-Embedding）和重排序（Qwen3-VL-Reranker）模型系列，通过多阶段训练和交叉编码器架构，在多种多模态检索任务上取得了最先进的结果。

papers.title: FocusUI: Efficient UI Grounding via Position-Preserving Visual Token Selection
papers.authors: Mingyu Ouyang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou, Hwee Tou Ng
papers.affiliations: National University of Singapore（Mingyu Ouyang, Mike Zheng Shou, Hwee Tou Ng）; University of Oxford（Kevin Qinghong Lin）
papers.intro: FocusUI是一种高效的UI grounding框架，通过指令相关的视觉token选择和位置保持的PosPad策略，在减少约70%视觉token的情况下，仅牺牲3.2%精度，同时实现1.44倍推理加速和17%内存降低。

papers.title: MAI-UI Technical Report: Real-World Centric Foundation GUI Agents
papers.authors: Hanzhang Zhou, Xu Zhang, Panrong Tong, Jianan Zhang, Liangyu Chen, Quyu Kong, Chenglin Cai, Chen Liu, Yue Wang, Jingren Zhou, Steven Hoi
papers.affiliations: Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出MAI-UI系列基础GUI代理（2B至235B-A22B），通过自进化数据管道、设备-云协作系统和在线强化学习框架，在GUI定位和移动导航上超越现有方法，同时实现隐私保护与成本效率。

papers.title: Step-GUI Technical Report
papers.authors: Haolong Yan, Jia Wang, Xin Huang, Yeqing Shen, Ziyang Meng, Zhimin Fan, Kaijun Tan, Jin Gao, Lieyu Shi, Mi Yang, Shiliang Yang, Zhirui Wang, Brian Li, Kang An, Chenyang Li, Lei Lei, Mengmeng Duan, Danxun Liang, Guodong Liu, Hang Cheng, Hao Wu, Jie Dong, Junhao Huang, Mei Chen, Renjie Yu, Shunshan Li, Xu Zhou, Yiting Dai, Yineng Deng, Yingdan Liang, Zelin Chen, Wen Sun, Chengxu Yan, Chunqin Xu, Dong Li, Fengqiong Xiao, Guanghao Fan, Guopeng Li, Guozhen Peng, Hongbing Li, Hang Li, Hongming Chen, Jingjing Xie, Jianyong Li, Jingyang Zhang, Jiaju Ren, Jiayu Yuan, Jianpeng Yin, Kai Cao, Liang Zhao, Liguo Tan, Liying Shi, Mengqiang Ren, Min Xu, Manjiao Liu, Mao Luo, Mingxin Wan, Na Wang, Nan Wu, Ning Wang, Peiyao Ma, Qingzhou Zhang, Qiao Wang, Qinlin Zeng, Qiong Gao, Qiongyao Li, Shangwu Zhong, Shuli Gao, Shaofan Liu, Shisi Gao, Shuang Luo, Xingbin Liu, Xiaojia Liu, Xiaojie Hou, Xin Liu, Xuanti Feng, Xuedan Cai, Xuan Wen, Xianwei Zhu, Xin Liang, Xin Liu, Xin Zhou, Yifan Sui, Yingxiu Zhao, Yukang Shi, Yunfang Xu, Yuqing Zeng, Yixun Zhang, Zejia Weng, Zhonghao Yan, Zhiguo Huang, Zhuoyu Wang, Zihan Yan, Zheng Ge, Jing Li, Yibo Zhu, Binxing Jiao, Xiangyu Zhang, Daxin Jiang
papers.affiliations: StepFun
papers.intro: 本文提出自演进训练管道（CSRS）、Step-GUI模型系列、GUI-MCP协议和AndroidDaily基准，从数据、模型、部署到评估完整推动实用化GUI智能体的发展。

papers.title: Using GUI Agent for Electronic Design Automation
papers.authors: Chunyi Li, Longfei Li, Zicheng Zhang, Xiaohong Liu, Min Tang, Weisi Lin, Guangtao Zhai
papers.affiliations: Chunyi Li 和 Weisi Lin 属于 Nanyang Technological University, Singapore; Longfei Li 和 Min Tang 属于 Shanghai Jiao Tong University, School of Integrated Circuit Design, Shanghai; Zicheng Zhang 和 Guangtao Zhai 属于 Shanghai AI Laboratory, Center of AI Evaluation, Shanghai; Xiaohong Liu 属于 Shanghai Jiao Tong University, John Hopcroft Center, Shanghai
papers.intro: 本文首次构建了面向电子设计自动化（EDA）的大规模GUI代理数据集GUI-EDA与评测基准，并提出专用指标EDAgent，通过引导反射机制在工业级CAD软件上超越电气工程博士生，将GUI代理从通用办公自动化扩展到高价值专业工程领域。

papers.title: Generalized Referring Expression Segmentation on Aerial Photos
papers.authors: Luís Marnoto, Alexandre Bernardino, Bruno Martins
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, visual grounding, Segment Anything
papers.affiliations: Luís Marnoto - INESC-ID and Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon; Alexandre Bernardino - Instituto de Sistemas e Robótica and Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon; Bruno Martins - INESC-ID and Instituto Superior Técnico, University of Lisbon
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个大规模航空影像指代分割数据集Aerial-D（包含37,288张图像和超过1,522,523条指代表达式），并采用RSRefSeg架构训练统一模型，实现了在现代和历史航空影像上基于自然语言描述的统一实例与语义分割。

papers.title: dots.ocr: Multilingual Document Layout Parsing in a Single Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Yumeng Li, Guang Yang, Hao Liu, Bowen Wang, Colin Zhang
papers.affiliations: hi lab, Xiaohongshu Inc
papers.intro: dots.ocr是首个通过单一视觉语言模型联合学习布局检测、内容识别和关系理解这三个核心任务的多语言文档布局解析框架，由可扩展的数据引擎驱动，在OmniDocBench和新提出的126语言XDocParse基准上达到最先进性能。

papers.title: UniGeoSeg: Towards Unified Open-World Segmentation for Geospatial Scenes
papers.authors: Shuo Ni; Di Wang; He Chen; Haonan Guo; Ning Zhang; Jing Zhang
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, scene understanding, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Wuhan University, Zhongguancun Academy, Hong Kong Polytechnic University
papers.intro: 本文提出GeoSeg-1M（首个百万级遥感指令驱动分割数据集）和UniGeoSeg统一框架，通过任务自适应文本增强、潜在知识记忆和渐进式训练实现指代、交互和推理分割的多任务统一与开放世界泛化。
